suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
})
xlsx_path <- "inputs/set-membership-111111111111.xlsx"
df <- read_excel(xlsx_path, sheet = "5 groups")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(df), "\n")
cat("NA per column:\n")
print(colSums(is.na(df)))
cat("Unique non-NA per column:\n")
print(sapply(df, function(x) length(unique(na.omit(x)))))
# Convert columns to character lists, drop NAs
sets <- lapply(df, function(col) unique(na.omit(as.character(col))))
names(sets) <- c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E")
cat("\nSet sizes:\n")
print(sapply(sets, length))
# Total universe
universe <- unique(unlist(sets, use.names = FALSE))
cat("Universe size:", length(universe), "\n")
# Save sets to global env for next cell
saveRDS(sets, "sets.rds")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
})
sets <- readRDS("sets.rds")
cat("Set sizes:\n")
print(sapply(sets, length))
# Compute Venn object
venn <- Venn(sets)
cat("\nIntersection counts (non-zero entries only):\n")
region_table <- venn@region %>% mutate(Item = lengths(.data$item))
print(region_table[order(-region_table$count), ])
# Proportional Venn diagram
p_prop <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDE2E2", high = "#C0392B") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2C3E50", "#2C3E50", "#2C3E50", "#2C3E50", "#2C3E50")) +
  labs(title = "Proportional Venn Diagram (5 sets)",
       subtitle = "Areas scaled to subset size; numbers show element counts") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "right")
ggsave("venn_proportional.png", p_prop, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("\nSaved venn_proportional.png\n")
# Also a non-proportional (overlapping circles) reference version
p_basic <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDE2E2", high = "#C0392B") +
  labs(title = "5-set Venn Diagram (intersections)") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"))
ggsave("venn_basic.png", p_basic, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved venn_basic.png\n")
# Display summary stats
cat("\n=== Region summary ===\n")
cat("Total non-empty regions:", nrow(region_table), "\n")
cat("Max intersection size:", max(region_table$count), "\n")
cat("Regions with >1 element:", sum(region_table$count > 1), "\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
})
sets <- readRDS("sets.rds")
# Compute intersections manually
intersect_members <- calculate_overlap(sets)
cat("Class of overlap result:", class(intersect_members), "\n")
str(intersect_members, max.level = 2)
# Get non-empty intersections
nonempty <- intersect_members[lengths(intersect_members) > 0]
cat("\nTotal non-empty regions:", length(nonempty), "\n")
# Build region table
region_table <- tibble(
  region = names(nonempty),
  count = lengths(nonempty),
  members = nonempty
) %>% arrange(desc(count))
print(head(region_table, 15))
cat("\nTotal unique elements (universe):", length(unique(unlist(sets))), "\n")

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(readxl)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(ggVennDiagram)
  library(venn)
})
sets <- readRDS("sets.rds")
cat("Set sizes:\n")
print(sapply(sets, length))
# --- 1. Proportional Euler/Venn using the `venn` package ---
# `venn()` draws Euler diagrams whose circle AREAS are proportional to set sizes.
png("venn_proportional.png", width = 2400, height = 2000, res = 200)
par(mar = c(2, 2, 4, 2))
venn(
  x        = sets,
  snames   = c("Group A", "Group B", "Group C", "Group D", "Group E"),
  ellipse   = FALSE,            # use circles (true area-proportional)
  zcolor   = c("#E64B35", "#4DBBD5", "#00A087", "#F39B7F", "#8491B4"),
  opacity  = 0.45,
  plotsize = 18,
  ilcs     = 0.7,
  sncs     = 0.9,
  borders  = TRUE,
  box      = FALSE
)
title(main = "Proportional Venn Diagram (5 groups, area-proportional circles)",
      cex.main = 1.4, font.main = 2)
dev.off()
cat("Saved venn_proportional.png\n")
# --- 2. Standard 5-set Venn with ggVennDiagram (for comparison) ---
p_basic <- ggVennDiagram(sets, label_alpha = 0, label = "count") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FDE2E2", high = "#C0392B", name = "Element\ncount") +
  scale_color_manual(values = rep("#2C3E50", 5)) +
  labs(title = "5-set Venn Diagram (intersection regions)") +
  theme_void(base_size = 12) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "right")
ggsave("venn_basic.png", p_basic, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 200)
cat("Saved venn_basic.png\n")
